ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Selective Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Selective Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Selective Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Selective Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Selective Listening.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

3. When practising Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

5. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

6. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.

7. When practising Phonological Awareness: Articulation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Articulation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Articulation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Articulation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Articulation.

8. When practising Imitative Speaking: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking: Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking: Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking: Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking: Fluency.

9. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

10. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading: Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading: Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading: Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading: Fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
